entities.summary: Nate Johnston is an American professional basketball player. He played briefly in the NBA for the Utah Jazz and the Portland Trail Blazers during the 1989–90 season. Johnston, a 6'8" forward, played collegiately at the University of Tampa from 1984–1988. Johnston was one of the first players drafted by the Miami Heat when they selected him in the third round of the 1988 NBA draft, prior to their inaugural season.
